A bank advertises 12% per annum compounded quarterly. Explain the difference between the nominal and the effective rate, and find the effective rate.
items.answer: Nominal 12% is the stated annual rate; the effective rate is the actual annual growth when interest is compounded: (1 + 0.03)⁴ − 1 = 12.55%.
